# axm rules disable

Disable instruction-file management

## When to use

Disable instruction-file management

## Usage

```bash
axm rules disable [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                    |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--scope` | choice | No       | Disable project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Disable instruction files**

```bash

```
